name: FurnitureBench: Reproducible Real-World Furniture Assembly Benchmark
description: FurnitureBench is an open-source real-world and simulated manipulation benchmark for complex, long-horizon furniture assembly. Developed by the CLVR Lab across KAIST and USC, FurnitureBench tackles the high-precision insertion, alignment, and screw fastening required to assemble commercial furniture kits (including chairs, desks, tables, and cabinets) using a Franka Emika Panda arm. The dataset comprises 219.6 hours of 5,100 successful human teleoperated assembly demonstrations collected using an Oculus Quest 2 VR controller and keyboard. Each demonstration records synchronized wrist and front camera visual streams, proprioceptive joint states, and action sequences.
